title: Ada and the Crown
author: Oscar Brightwater
blurb: Casper Coldharbour, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
